q1.explanationZh: Martine 在短信里问“Did you say you booked for 5 or 6 o’clock?”（你说订的是5点还是6点？），她是在确认和 Ben 见面的时间。A 错：她已经说了在网球中心见面；B 错：她没有改变计划，还说待会儿见。

q2.explanationZh: 告示开头写着“New in store!”（店里新到），说明一些很棒的冒险故事书刚刚到货。B 错：青少年图书只在一楼（1st Floor），不是每层都有；C 错：告示没说冒险故事最受欢迎。

q3.explanationZh: 应用介绍里写“Keep details in one place – including date to finish homework”，它能帮学生记住完成作业的日期，也就是什么时候要交作业。A 错：没有提到用哪个网站；C 错：可以和老师同学分享作业，但不是帮你记住谁能帮你。

q4.explanationZh: 告示写导览“not included in ticket price”（不包含在门票里），所以参加导览要另外付钱。A 错：导览只有上午10点一场，不是每小时一次；C 错：“12 people only”是说导览团最多12人，不是说12人以上的团体要订票才能进城堡。

q5.explanationZh: Mr Blake 说如果今天下午6点不来体育场训练，就不能参加周六的比赛，也就是告诉全队今晚必须来训练。A 错：邮件没有介绍周六比赛的情况；C 错：没有说要换地方训练。

q6.explanationZh: Daniel 说奶奶送的 Race 游戏他已经有了，问 Lucy“Would you like it?”，还说自己没用过，所以是把用不着的游戏送给 Lucy。A 错：他不是要借游戏；B 错：他没有问 Lucy 觉得这个游戏怎么样。

q7.explanationZh: Tania 说新闻博物馆和大多数博物馆不同，因为它更多展示事件而不是物品。A 错：Julia 只说卡通博物馆很小，没说它和别的博物馆不一样。

evidence.quote: is different from most other museums because it’s more about events than things

q8.explanationZh: Tania 没来得及看完所有东西，所以已经决定再去一次。A 错：Julia 说不打算再去；B 错：Becky 也说不会再去了。

evidence.quote: so I’ve already decided to go back

q9.explanationZh: Julia 说去的路上迷了路，只好向别人问路，说明博物馆很难找。B、C 都没有提到找路的困难。

evidence.quote: we had to ask for directions because we got lost on our way there

q10.explanationZh: Becky 说小时候和爸爸去过，但这一次是她第一次自己一个人去。A 错：Julia 是和妈妈一起去的；C 错：Tania 也是妈妈带她去的。

evidence.quote: but this was my first visit on my own

q11.explanationZh: Tania 说有一个关于摄影记者和他们工作的展览，她很喜欢了解他们怎样拍出好照片。摄影记者就是一种有趣的职业。A 错：Julia 看的展览是关于卡通的历史，画家谈自己的工作是在绘画课上。

evidence.quote: There was also an exhibition about photo-journalists and their work. I really enjoyed learning how they get such good pictures.

q12.explanationZh: Julia 说最棒的部分是参加了一小时的绘画课，还自己画了卡通，这就是在博物馆参加活动。C 错：Tania 最喜欢的是在小剧场看新闻短片，她没有动手参加活动。

evidence.quote: The best part for me was joining a one-hour drawing class.

q13.explanationZh: Becky 说恐龙展是博物馆里最热闹的部分，挤满了人，说明这个展览比其他展览更受欢迎。A 错：Julia 只说看了各种展览；C 错：Tania 没有说哪个展览人多。

evidence.quote: It was the busiest part of the museum and full of people

q14.explanationZh: Sophie 报名后就忘了这件事，几周后听说自己被选上时“couldn’t believe it”（简直不敢相信），说明她很惊讶自己被选中。C 错：她知道很多同学也想去；A 错：文中没说她担心路途遥远。

evidence.quote: A few weeks later, I couldn’t believe it when I heard I was in the group.

q15.explanationZh: 老师让 Sophie 写博客记录大家的经历，所以她在参观期间写了关于这次旅行的文章。A 错：拍短片的是 Toby；C 错：每天的活动是 Mr Scott 安排的。

evidence.quote: He also asked me to keep a blog of our experiences

q16.explanationZh: 工程师和宇航员告诉 Sophie 要做些什么才能在太空项目里找到工作，也就是给了她工作方面的建议。A、C 文中都没有提到。

evidence.quote: told me what I needed to do to get a job with a space project

q17.explanationZh: 最后一段从“When I got back to school”开始，讲她回到学校后给同学做讲座的经过，所以是在描述回来以后发生的事。B 错：没有介绍宇航员的工作；C 错：她没有说这次旅行有多重要。

evidence.quote: When I got back to school, I had to give a talk about the trip to the other students.

q18.explanationZh: Sophie 说最喜欢的部分是最后回答同学们的问题。A 错：她觉得记住关于火星的知识很难；B 错：大家喜欢她的照片让她高兴，但不是她最喜欢的部分。

evidence.quote: My favourite part was answering students’ questions at the end.

q19.explanationZh: be called + 名字表示“被叫作……”：白狼也被叫作北极狼。known 要说 known as；described 要说 described as，后面都不能直接接名字。

evidence.quote: the Arctic wolf, lives in the Canadian Arctic and northern Greenland

q20.explanationZh: area 表示“地区”，the area 指北极附近这一带地区仍然有不少白狼。part 一般要说 part of 某地；piece 指“一块、一片”东西，不能指地区。

evidence.quote: still has quite a

q21.explanationZh: a large number of 是固定搭配，表示“大量的”。tall 形容身高；full 是“满的”，都不能修饰 number。

evidence.quote: number of white wolves

q22.explanationZh: travel many kilometres 表示“走（行进）很多公里”去找食物。pass 是“经过某处”；make 不能和距离搭配。

evidence.quote: many kilometres a day to find food

q23.explanationZh: change to + 颜色表示“变成某种颜色”：小狼蓝色的眼睛在约10周大时变成黄金色。become 后面不加 to；take 没有“变成”的意思。

evidence.quote: to a yellow-gold colour when the wolves are about 10 weeks old

q24.explanationZh: 前一句说狼的眼睛会变成黄金色，这一句却说还能找到少数蓝眼睛的成年狼，前后意思相反，要用表示转折的 However。Especially 是“尤其”；Instead 是“代替”，都不合适。

evidence.quote: it is possible to find a few adult wolves with blue eyes

q25.explanationZh: would like / would love to do sth 表示“想要做某事”：我很想提高我的英语。

evidence.quote: to improve my English and writing to you will help

q26.explanationZh: live with sb 表示“和某人住在一起”：我和父母、姐姐一起住在布达佩斯的一套公寓里。

evidence.quote: my parents and my sister Adela

q27.explanationZh: older 是比较级，后面用 than 引出比较对象：她比我大一岁（a year older than me）。

evidence.quote: She is a year older

q28.explanationZh: the same 是固定搭配，same 前面要用 the：我们在同一所学校上学。

evidence.quote: same school

q29.explanationZh: as much as I can 表示“尽我所能地多”：冬天我尽可能多地去滑雪。

evidence.quote: I can. My parents often take me to Dobogókő

q30.explanationZh: 问对方空闲时喜欢做什么，用疑问词 What：What do you enjoy doing in your free time?

evidence.quote: do you enjoy doing in your free time?

q31.sampleAnswer:
Hi Spencer,
My favourite game on my phone is mystery. I love it because it is about fun stories. I play it really often, I’m afraid to say that every day.
Lots of love,
Amanda

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：说出你手机上最喜欢的游戏；说明为什么喜欢它；说明多久玩一次
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response:
Hi Spencer,
My favourite game on my phone is mystery. I love it because it is about fun stories. I play it really often, I’m afraid to say that every day.
Lots of love,
Amanda
anchors.noteZh: 很好地完成了任务：三个问题都回答了，读者能完全了解信息；组织得好，Spencer 的每个问题都用单独一句话回答；用了一些连接词和指代词（it, because）；词汇简单但恰当、没有错误（I love it, it is about, really often, I’m afraid to say）；最后一句的 that 用错了，但意思仍然清楚。内容5/条理性4/语言4。

anchors.response: Spencer, I am happy for your new game. My favourite game on my phone is Soda. I am very much interested to play this game. I often play this game in a day.
anchors.noteZh: 较好地完成了任务：尝试回答了 Spencer 的所有问题，但 I often play this game in a day 的意思不太清楚；行文有逻辑，每个问题单独一句回答；用了指代词连接上下文（this game）；词汇和语法比较基础（I am happy, I often play），但大体准确、恰当。内容4/条理性3/语言3。

q31.explanationZh: 满分邮件要回答 Spencer 的三个问题：你手机上最喜欢的游戏是什么、为什么喜欢、多久玩一次，并用 because、and、so 等连接词把句子连起来，表达清楚（比如说 every day、twice a week）。

q32.sampleAnswer: John joined the bike race yesterday. In the beginning, John was in the last place. He rode the bike regularly. But the other players rode rapidly. When they rode for a quite long, they were getting tired and slower. In that time, John had already arrived to the finish.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：四个人参加自行车比赛；穿条纹上衣的骑手落在最后；他/她最后第一个冲过终点，大家为他/她欢呼
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response: John joined the bike race yesterday. In the beginning, John was in the last place. He rode the bike regularly. But the other players rode rapidly. When they rode for a quite long, they were getting tired and slower. In that time, John had already arrived to the finish.
anchors.noteZh: 很好地完成了任务：三幅图都写到了，读者能完全了解故事；故事组织得好，用了多种连接和指代词语（In the beginning, But, When, they, In that time）；词汇切合话题，大多用得正确（joined, last place, tired, the finish）；有一些词汇错误（regularly / rapidly, a quite long），但不影响理解；过去时使用恰当、前后一致。内容5/条理性3/语言4。

anchors.response: Four people entered to championship of bike and enjoyed competition each other. One guy had a surprise at back and that guy won the championship. So the guy won, people were watching and shouting for him.
anchors.noteZh: 较好地完成了任务：三幅图都写到了，但由于语言错误，第二幅图的内容不太清楚（had a surprise at back）；一些简单的衔接手段用得正确（and, One guy, that guy），但也有用错的（So the guy won），让意思更难理解；大部分词汇切题（entered, championship, competition, won），但也有错误（这里用 race 比 championship 更合适）；过去时用得一致，但其他语法有错误（entered to championship, enjoyed competition each other）。内容4/条理性3/语言3。

q32.explanationZh: 满分故事要把三幅图都写到：四个人开始自行车比赛、穿条纹上衣的骑手落在最后、最后他/她却第一个到达终点，大家欢呼，并用 at first、but、when、in the end 等连接词把情节连贯地串起来，用一般过去时叙述。
